BETTING AND GAMING LEVY (AMENDMENT)
to amend the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No. 40 of 1988
A
BILL

(Published in the Gazette on March 24, 2023)
STATEMENT OF LEGAL EFFECT
Clause 2 : This clause amends section 2 of the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No. 40of 1988 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) and the legal effect of thesection as amended is to–
(a)increase the levy on the gross collection from persons carrying on the businessof bookmaker or the business of gaming;
(b)dissuade a citizen of Sri Lanka from entering a place of business of gaming bycharging a casino entrance levy of United States dollars fifty; and
(c)provide for the liability of a person who fails to collect and pay the levies underthis Act.

Clause 3 : This clause amends section 2A of the principal enactment and the legal effectof the section as amended is to provide for the requirement to obtain a license and for theregistration with the Department of Inland Revenue in respect of a person who carries onthe business of gaming and business of a bookmaker.
Clause 4 : This clause amends section 4 of the principal enactment and the legal effectof the section as amended is to–
(a)provide for the payments of the levy on the gross collection and for the casinoentrance levy on instalments as provided for other levies; and
(b)extend the application of certain provisions of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24of 2017 being consequential to the application of clause 3.

Clause 5 : This clause amends section 5 of the principal enactment and the legal effectof the section as amended is to provide for the application of certain provisions of theTurnover Tax Act, No. 69 of 1981 in respect of recovery of Tax, power to searchbuildings, places and business premises and official secrecy, with subsection (5) of section 4of the principal enactment

Clause 6 : This clause amends section 7 of the principal enactment by the insertion ofthe new definitions for the words and expressions bookmaker, casino, citizen of Sri Lankaand Commissioner-General and Deputy Commissioner.

Clause 7 : This clause replaces the Schedule to the principal enactment by specifyingthe increased amounts to be paid for certain levies every year commencing on or afterApril 1,2023 on by a person carrying the business of a bookmaker or business of gaming.

3.Section 2A of the principal enactment is herebyamended as follows:-
(1)by the insertion immediately after subsection (1) ofthat section of the following new subsections:-

“(1A) Every person who carries on the businessof gaming referred to in subsection (1) of section 2shall be entitled to obtain a license issued undersection 2 of the Casino Business (Regulations) Act,No. 17 of 2010 and shall register with theDepartment of Inland Revenue within one monthfrom the date of issuance of such license:

Provided however, any person who has obtainedsuch license under section 2 of the Casino Business(Regulations) Act, No. 17 of 2010 for the businessof gaming and has not registered with theDepartment of Inland Revenue before the date ofoperation of this Act, shall register with theDepartment of Inland Revenue within one monthfrom such date of operation:
Provided further, for the purpose of this sectionthe business of gaming shall involve providinggaming opportunities at a casino.

(1B) Every person who carries on the business ofbookmaker referred to in subsection (1) of section2 shall register with the Department of InlandRevenue within one month from the date ofcommencement of the business:

Provided however, any person who hascommenced the business of bookmaker before theoperation of this Act and has not registered withthe Department of Inland Revenue shall registerwith the Department of Inland Revenue within onemonth from such date of operation.
